chats.answer:
A power bank with an AC outlet lets you plug in devices using a regular wall plug (110V/120V), rather than just USB-C or USB-A.

There are two main types:

Portable AC power banks (under 100Wh): Compact enough for a backpack, useful for laptops, camera chargers, and small electronics.

Portable power stations (100–300Wh+): Larger batteries that can run more devices for longer, but are heavier and generally not allowed on airplanes.

Look for a model with a pure sine wave AC inverter, especially if you plan to power sensitive electronics.
